description: A form section for editing general organization settings including name, slug, description, logo, and website. All inputs use native form elements with associated labels.

keyboard.action: Moves focus between form fields (logo button, name, slug, description, website, cancel, save)
Submits the form when a button is focused

focus.notes: Focus follows standard tab order through all form controls. Focus ring is visible on all interactive elements.

announcements: Each input is announced with its associated label
Buttons are announced with their text content

contrast.text: Meets WCAG AA (>4.5:1 for labels and input text)
contrast.ui: Meets WCAG AA (>3:1 for borders and focus rings)

consumerResponsibilities: Ensure the onSave handler provides feedback (e.g., a toast) on success or failure
If adding custom validation, display error messages associated with their inputs via aria-describedby
